blocks.text: Welcome to Foundations Calculator. This Field Guide is the home manual for the mod: calculators, machines, circuits, research, power systems, greenhouses, automation and troubleshooting all live here. You can read it from the Calculator book itself, through a compatible master-guide reader, or through the generated Patchouli mirror when Patchouli is installed.
Start here if this is your first time

rows: Open Getting Started: First 10 Minutes. It gives you a short route from your first Calculator to your first powered processing machine.
Use the search box whenever you know the name of a machine, material, circuit state or symptom.
Follow blue related-entry links instead of trying to memorize the whole book. Back and Forward preserve your reading trail.
When a page shows live values, those values come from the current server. Static examples are labelled as defaults and can differ in a customized pack.

blocks.text: This guide explains the mod; it does not grant research or bypass server progression. Reading an entry, Patchouli page, or master-guide page never unlocks a recipe by itself.

The same Foundations Guide API content remains available to a future master-guide mod. R9 also publishes a resource-only Patchouli mirror under foundations_calculator:field_guide. Patchouli does not create a second Calculator book item: it is told to use the existing Foundations Calculator Field Guide item.
